name: Bug report

## Versions and environment

Plugin / Hermes / Git / Python / OS:

## Reproduction

Use a disposable repository and temporary HERMES_HOME. List the tool call or CLI command and relevant settings.

## Expected and actual behavior

Include sanitized `hermes autosave status --json` and relevant ledger errors. Do not attach secrets, session
transcripts, raw databases or proprietary snapshots.

## Safety checks

Did HEAD, branches, real index bytes or `git status --porcelain` change unexpectedly?
